Reviewer dimension: SIGN
Paper summary: The paper proposes "SamplePairing," a simple data augmentation technique for image classification that synthesizes new training samples by averaging two randomly selected images from the training set, while retaining the label of only one of the images. The authors demonstrate that this method significantly reduces validation error rates on standard benchmarks (ILSVRC 2012, CIFAR-10, CIFAR-100, SVHN) and is particularly effective when the training set size is limited. The technique is presented as orthogonal to other augmentation methods and regularization techniques, with a specific training protocol involving intermittent disabling of the augmentation to allow for fine-tuning.
